profile.design: All inventory paid on the first calendar boundary before trading. No subsequent purchases, replacements, contributions or live cap. Same-resource arms start 20; routed arms retain fixed R=4 even after deaths. Exact exposure freezes the unrestricted model's realized per-trade copies. A separate R=20 full-tape target tests 100 initial seats and, if necessary, larger inventories. Capacity search finds the first successful tested size in steps of 20, not a global minimum.
